Electricity, diesel, final energy and CO: Ugesi, udizili, amandla okugcina ne-CO2e ngonyaka kulayini ngamunye, ohlotsheni ngalunye lwezokuthutha nakunethiwekhi yonke, kanye nobukhulu nge-km yemoto ngayinye nange-km yesihlalo ngasinye.
Traction energy and greenhouse gas emiss: Amandla okudonsa nokukhishwa kwamagesi abamba ukushisa kwelayini ngalinye ngonyaka, ohlotsheni ngalunye lwezokuthutha nakunethiwekhi, kusuka kuma-km ezimoto ahanjwa yilayini ngalinye: ugesi esiteshini esincane noma kushaja, udizili ngamalitha, ne-CO2e kusuka ebukhulwini bokukhishwa kwegridi nodizili kusuka emthonjeni kuya esondweni. Kuboniswa kuthebhu Amatafula.
